checks.passes_when: Found a reply from Cowork (it says "Sent by Copilot Cowork") in your mail.
checks.hint: Go to step 1.4. Keep or send at least one of the three reply drafts from Cowork.

checks.passes_when: Found "Helix messaging review" on your calendar.
checks.hint: Go to step 1.8. Approve the first focus block on the approval card.

checks.passes_when: Found "Helix launch checklist" on your calendar.
checks.hint: Go to step 1.9. Ask for the second focus block after you choose Always allow.

checks.passes_when: There is no "Helix status review" event on your calendar.
checks.hint: Go to step 1.10. Cancel the third request. If "Helix status review" is on your calendar, delete it.

checks.passes_when: Found a risk register with a "Source evidence" column in your OneDrive.
checks.hint: Go to step 2.1. The risk register needs a "Source evidence" column. Ask Cowork to add it.

checks.passes_when: Found UNCONFIRMED in your readiness files.
checks.hint: Go to step 2.10. A risk with no named owner must say UNCONFIRMED. Ask Cowork to fix it.

checks.passes_when: Found the launch-status-report skill in your OneDrive.
checks.hint: Go to step 3.3. Select Approve on the Copy file card for skills/launch-status-report.

checks.passes_when: Found a Helix-Status report in your OneDrive.
checks.hint: Go to step 3.6. Start a New task and ask for this week's Helix launch status report.

checks.passes_when: Found the "Helix launch briefing" email in your Inbox.
checks.hint: Go to step 4.3. Tick Run once now, select Schedule, then select Send on the card.

checks.passes_when: Found the helix-meeting-prep skill in your OneDrive.
checks.hint: Go to step 5.2. Select Approve on the Copy file card for skills/helix-meeting-prep.
Go to step 5.3. Add brief-template.docx to the helix-meeting-prep skill.
Go to step 5.9. Create a Word file named Skill-Inventory.docx in OneDrive.

third-block-cancelled.note: Off to match the published scorecard. When on, the 10 points need at least one focus block, so a learner who skips M1 does not earn them.

seed_rules.note: No seeded mail, post, event, file name or file content may contain these phrases (case-insensitive).
